data.description: The Seating Twister Three Way has three orange seats arranged around one frame, each with its own handle, so three people can do seated waist twists at the same time. Users face outward in different directions, which keeps the machine compact and lets friends chat while they exercise. It suits busy senior citizens' areas, society gardens and municipal parks where older users come in groups in the morning and evening. All three seats and the frame trim are in Play Orange. Request the drawing and warranty terms from us when you ask for a price. On the Seating Twister Three Way, our standard cover of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings would apply, which we will confirm. Ask us for a layout.

items.pText: The Seating Twister Three Way has three orange seats arranged around one frame, each with its own handle, so three people can do seated waist twists at the same time. Users face outward in different directions, which keeps the machine compact and lets friends chat while they exercise. It suits busy senior citizens' areas, society gardens and municipal parks where older users come in groups in the morning and evening. All three seats and the frame trim are in Play Orange. Request the drawing and warranty terms from us when you ask for a price. On the Seating Twister Three Way, our standard cover of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings would apply, which we will confirm. Ask us for a layout.

Three rotating seats share one central frame, so grouting is the safer fixing on most grounds. Check each seat bearing separately during maintenance, because one worn seat can wobble while the others feel fine. Leave a walking gap around the whole unit.
